name: Endou Harue
source:
Janitor/cleaning maid for office. Is kind married woman that is from upper class calling her job a social experiment. Tends to get along with the protagonist often making him side dishes for lunch

[spoiler] Has problems with lactation ever since she was young despite not being pregnant. Is ashamed and embarrassed forced to wear breast pads. [spoiler]
translation:
Janitor/cleaning maid for office. Is kind married woman that is from upper class calling her job a social experiment. Tends to get along with the protagonist often making him side dishes for lunch

[spoiler] Has problems with lactation ever since she was young despite not being pregnant. Is ashamed and embarrassed forced to wear breast pads. [spoiler]
